# Legacy billing notes

These notes describe the retired invoice batch job and are intentionally out
of date. They have nothing to do with the text utilities or any current code.

- The nightly batch ran at 02:00 and wrote invoices to `/var/billing/out`.
- Invoice numbers were generated by `nextInvoiceNumber(prefix, year)`, which no
  longer exists anywhere in the repository.
- The `BILLING_LEGACY_MODE` setting selected the old tax table.
